_doc: Corrections to OpenJLPT words, keyed by OpenJLPT id: the written form (word), reading or JMdict entry the course uses instead of the upstream one. The upstream spelling stays an accepted form. Each fix says why. Applied by sources:fetch (to keep the JMdict entry) and data:build.

f9a20b5203.why: OpenJLPT links しかる to 然る (adj-pn, "a particular"); the N4 lists mean 叱る (to scold).

b48d0c99d4.why: OpenJLPT links せっけん to 節倹 (thrift); the N5 lists mean 石鹸 (soap). 石けん (JMdict, common in everyday writing) is accepted too.

d7960dc78d.why: Standard okurigana (送り仮名の付け方): 終わる.

a2694d259e.why: ご飯 is the usual spelling (JMdict lists it first).

8fb005254a.why: The noun けが is used on its own (けがをしました, 足のけが), not only as けがする.

98bc6f72ae.why: 朝ご飯 and 朝御飯 (JMdict) are accepted like 昼ご飯 and 晩ご飯.

0b492c3209.why: 昼ご飯 is the usual spelling (JMdict lists it first).

246b5ae84d.why: 晩ご飯, like ご飯 and 昼ご飯.

8bd7bc72e8.why: ご主人 is the usual spelling (JMdict lists it first).

aac669551b.why: The noun is written 答え (JMdict lists it first).

771fbe6b4d.why: まいつき is the everyday reading (JMdict lists it first); まいげつ is formal.

9661cbac61.why: In the sense "give" taught at N5, あげる is usually written in kana.

d980cb1531.why: ゆっくり (without と) is the usual form of the adverb.

ba20bc66d0.why: The N5 grammar point 全然〜ない (zenzen-nai) needs it; the lists put the word itself in N4.
